title: Star Wars RPG
description:
This is a Star Wars RPG where you can be who ever you want and do whatever you want, this is to have




UPDATE 1/9/2026: I can’t believe that almost 2 years ago I made this scenario for fun because of my love for Star Wars and now it has brought over 14 thousand people joy. Thank you all so much and Happy New Year!





UPDATE 8/27/2025: I have fixed the thing people have been bothering me about for over a year, ${}, and I apologize for not fixing it. Thank you all for over 8k plays and I hope that the scenario is 100% better!
